import unreal,json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('C:/Users/tarik/Documents/GitHub/AGP/.scratch/splatmap-v2/manual-acceptance-20261024/native-mask-readback')
root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
a=next(a for a in unreal.get_editor_subsystem(unreal.EditorActorSubsystem).get_all_level_actors() if isinstance(a,unreal.Landscape))
record=json.loads(unreal.AGPAcceptanceLibrary.describe_landscape(a))
results=[]
for c in record['components']:
 for index,path in enumerate(c['textures']):
  texture=unreal.find_object(None,path)
  if not texture: raise RuntimeError('Native texture object not found')
  task=unreal.AssetExportTask()
  task.object=texture
  task.filename=str(root/(c['component']+'_'+str(index)+'.png'))
  task.automated=True
  task.prompt=False
  task.replace_identical=False
  task.exporter=unreal.TextureExporterPNG()
  ok=unreal.Exporter.run_asset_export_task(task)
  results.append({'component':c['component'],'index':index,'source':path,'output':task.filename,'success':bool(ok),'errors':list(task.errors)})
  if not ok: raise RuntimeError('Independent texture export failed')
(root/'readback.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
